entities.name: Verónica Abad Rojas
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Verónica Abad Rojas is an Ecuadorian business coach and politician who served as the 53rd Vice President of Ecuador from 2023 to 2025 under the first term of President Daniel Noboa. Prior to her vice presidency, she was an unsuccessful candidate for mayor of Cuenca in 2023 and previously worked on international projects to support entrepreneurship for young people and women.
